run_hotpotqa_distractor_teacher: run the ParlAI HotpotQA distractor teacher to load and serve HotpotQA distractor dataset examples
run_hotpotqa_fullwiki_teacher: run the ParlAI HotpotQA fullwiki teacher to load and serve HotpotQA fullwiki dataset examples
run_hotpotqa_default_teacher: run the ParlAI HotpotQA default teacher which uses the fullwiki variant for QA tasks
review_distractor_teacher_class: review the DistractorTeacher class that extends ParlAIDialogTeacher for the HotpotQA distractor dataset
review_fullwiki_teacher_class: review the FullwikiTeacher class that extends ParlAIDialogTeacher for the HotpotQA fullwiki dataset
